content: Potiguar University, also known as Universidade Potiguar (UnP) in Portuguese, is a private higher education institution located in Natal, Brazil. It provides a wide range of degree programs in fields such as technology, law, environmental studies, architecture, tourism, social work, arts, and sciences. Notably, UnP holds the distinction of being the first private university established in the state of Rio Grande do Norte, Brazil. Founded in 1981, Universidade Potiguar has built a strong reputation for academic excellence. It offers both undergraduate and graduate degree programs through seven distinct academic faculties. These faculties operate across campuses situated in the cities of Natal and Mossoró, which are located in the northeastern region of Brazil. With an enrollment of over 32,600 students, UnP is recognized as one of the largest post-secondary institutions in the region. Its School of Health Sciences is particularly renowned for being one of the most advanced in Latin America. Additionally, the university's online and distance learning programs, as well as its health sciences programs, are highly respected. The university is organized into seven academic faculties, which include the Faculty of Business and Management, the Faculty of Communication and Arts, the Faculty of Culinary Arts, the Faculty of Education, the Faculty of Engineering and Information Technology, the Faculty of Health Sciences, and the Faculty of Law. UnP operates multiple campuses across the cities of Natal and Mossoró. In Natal, the campuses include Unidade Floriano Peixoto, Unidade Nascimento de Castro, Unidade Roberto Freire, and Unidade Salgado Filho. In Mossoró, the university operates the Unidade Mossoró campus. The university is deeply committed to social responsibility and actively engages with the local community. It provides high-quality services that involve students from all areas of the university. These services include health clinics that cater to thousands of outpatients annually, legal aid services, digital education programs, and formal educational projects aimed at assisting individuals from low socioeconomic backgrounds. Additionally, UnP supports business and entrepreneurship initiatives, as well as projects that promote environmental sustainability and address ecological concerns.
